title: TenantSecurityTenantInfo - Data API
description: Stores information on changes related to the tenant history. This object is available in API version 56.0 and later.

DetailIdentifier.description: The unique identifier for this record.

Instance.description: The instance that the tenant is being hosted on.

MyDomainName.description: The name of the domain for this tenant.

Name.description: The name of the metric for which the data is being collected.

SandboxAlias.description: The alias specified by the user when the user creates a Sandbox.

SandboxType.description: The type specified by the user when the user creates a Sandbox.

Status.description: The status of the tenant. For example, active or inactive.

TenantName.description: The name of the tenant (org) that this record is for.

TenantType.description: The type of tenant in this org.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **TenantSecurityTenantInfoChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
- **TenantSecurityTenantInfoFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **TenantSecurityTenantInfoHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **TenantSecurityTenantInfoOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **TenantSecurityTenantInfoShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
